business_problem: Belgotex needed to replace disparate systems and manual processes that kept manufacturing, accounting, sales, and customer engagement disconnected and made data hard to trust.
solution_summary: Belgotex took a big-bang approach to replacing older manufacturing and accounting systems with a broad Dynamics 365 and Power Platform rollout. The company wanted all major functions—from finance and supply chain to sales, customer service, and customer-facing portals—to share one data-driven operating model so departments could collaborate and management could see what was really happening across orders, production, and market demand. Key components include Dynamics 365 Finance, Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Dynamics 365 Sales, Power Apps, Power Pages, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric. Belgotex gained unprecedented operational visibility, improved collaboration between departments, reduced manual work, and created a more data-driven way to align market demand, factory output, and customer engagement.
